ANLABY REGENT ROAD

Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.

A versatile triumph for British screen art... From the Press... For a wager would you stay the night alone—in the chamber of horrors—drama—comedy—thrills.

description: A vintage movie poster advertises 'The Chamber of Horrors' starring Frank Stanmore and Joan Maude, highlighting thrills, drama, and comedy.
